name: Horde Trauma
summary: At Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands, Horde Trauma calls skilled healers to the front lines. Doctor Gregory Victor needs hands ready to save lives under extreme pressure.

sections.title: A Summons from Hammerfall
sections.body: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits, Arnok, the orc first aid trainer, tells proficient healers they have caught Doctor Gregory Victor's attention. Victor oversees Horde Trauma from Hammerfall in the contested hills of the Arathi Highlands. Arnok regards the summons as the highest step in a battlefield surgeon's career.

sections.title: The Brutal Work of Battlefield Triage
sections.body: At Hammerfall, constant skirmishes with Stromgarde's forces and hostile local factions leave Doctor Victor flooded with wounded grunts, raiders, and scouts. The chief physician skips the pleasantries. He sends newcomers into their scrubs to prove their worth in fast, brutal emergency triage.

faq.answer: Horde Trauma is the Horde's medical and surgical branch on the front lines. Doctor Gregory Victor leads it from Hammerfall, where its members treat combat injuries and perform emergency triage amid chaos.

faq.q: Who sends me on this assignment?
faq.answer: Arnok, the orc first aid trainer in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits, issues the summons. He regards service under Doctor Gregory Victor as the highest step in an aspiring field medic's career.

faq.q: Where is Doctor Gregory Victor located?
faq.answer: Doctor Gregory Victor is stationed in the medical infirmary at Hammerfall in the northeastern Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Hammerfall?
faq.answer: When you arrive, Doctor Victor tells you to don your scrubs for the follow-up assignment, Triage. Under high stress, you prioritize and treat wounded soldiers whose condition is worsening quickly, before their injuries overcome them.

faq.q: Why is Hammerfall so desperate for field medics?
faq.answer: Hammerfall is surrounded by hostilities in Arathi and faces constant conflict with human forces, syndicate operatives, and local beasts. Casualties stream into the encampment, pushing its small medical staff to the limit.

faq.q: Can Alliance players take this assignment?
faq.answer: No. Horde Trauma is for members of the Horde. The Alliance has an equivalent medical evaluation led by Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen at Theramore Isle.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you rely on rugged battlefield surgeons to keep grunts patched up and fighting through brutal frontier conflicts like those in the Arathi Highlands.
As a priest, you can seal wounds with divine magic. Secular triage teaches you to judge who can be saved when your mana runs dry.
